2.desc: When the wearer uses Follow-Up ATK, increases ATK by 24% for 2 turn(s). When an enemy target gets defeated, increases CRIT DMG for all allies by 12% in the current battle. This effect cannot stack.
2.desc_cn: 装备者施放追加攻击时，攻击力提高24%，持续2回合。当敌方目标被消灭时，我方全体在本场战斗中暴击伤害提高12%，该效果无法叠加。

2.desc: Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by 8%. When entering combat, if the wearer and another teammate are both Trailblaze Companions characters, increases the wearer's CRIT DMG by 32%.
2.desc_cn: 使装备者的暴击率提高8%。进入战斗时，若装备者与另一名队友均为开拓同行角色，使装备者的暴击伤害提高32%。

2.desc: When entering combat, if the wearer's Max Energy is greater than or equal to 200, for every 1 excess point, increases the wearer's DMG dealt by 0.2%, up to a max increase of 32%.
2.desc_cn: 进入战斗时，若装备者能量上限大于等于200点，每超过1点使装备者造成的伤害提高0.2%，最多提高32%。
